test_std_exception: test that pybind11 correctly throws and catches a standard C++ exception as a Python RuntimeError
test_cross_module_exceptions: test that exceptions thrown in one pybind11 module can be caught in another module
test_custom: test custom pybind11 exception types including MyException, MyException5, and their subclass hierarchy
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception propagation and handling across the pybind11 boundary
test_python_call_in_catch: test that Python code can be safely called from within a C++ exception destructor
